session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Higher Low Double Bottom, Then Small Pullback Bull Trend'. A minor wedge spike to 4668 fails, then a higher low double bottom wedge at 4657 reverses the market; a breakout above the wedge lower high at 4668 starts a small pullback bull trend that becomes a bull trending trading range and closes with a measured move up at 4680.

events.label: wedge
events.outcome_reason: minor wedge of higher lows lifted the opening range into a spike to 4668
events.evidence: magenta dotted wedge lines in the early blue shaded range

events.label: failed_breakout
events.outcome_reason: breakout to 4668 failed and the market sold off to 4657
events.evidence: red Failed breakout text with red arrow at the 08:05 spike top

events.label: wedge
events.outcome_reason: higher low double bottom wedge at 4657 formed a major trend reversal bottom
events.evidence: magenta wedge lines into the 08:55 low 4657 with green dotted double bottom line

events.label: breakout
events.outcome_reason: breakout above the wedge lower high at 4668 launched the bull trend
events.evidence: orange shaded 10:15-10:25 bull bars with orange arrow and text

events.label: channel
events.outcome_reason: small pullback bull trend ground up from 4657 to 4680 all day
events.evidence: magenta dotted bull trend line and green arrows up the day

events.label: measured_move
events.outcome_reason: measured move up from the midday range reached the blue dotted target at 4683
